questions.question: Which Project type does start.spring.io select by default, so you must change it to follow this course?
questions.explanation: Initializr defaults to Gradle - Groovy; this course uses Maven, so switch Project to Maven.

questions.question: You generate a project with curl, using groupId=com.citylibrary and artifactId=book-catalog, and no packageName. Which package does the main class live in?
questions.explanation: A hyphen is not allowed in a Java package name, so the generator turns it into an underscore.

questions.question: The Name field is catalog. What is the generated main class called?
questions.explanation: Initializr takes the Name, capitalises it and adds Application.

questions.question: A student generates a project with no dependencies and adds a @RestController. The app prints Started ... and then exits, with no Tomcat line in the log. What is wrong?
options: The controller is in the wrong package
The Spring Web dependency is missing, so there is no web server to keep the app running
The port must be set before the app can start
questions.explanation: Without spring-boot-starter-webmvc there is no embedded server, so the app has nothing to wait for and stops.

questions.question: The Spring Boot list shows 4.2.0 (SNAPSHOT), 4.1.1, 4.2.0 (M2) and 4.1.2 (SNAPSHOT). Which should a beginner pick?
questions.explanation: Plain version numbers are finished releases; SNAPSHOT and M builds are unfinished test versions.
